summary:
CRC outreach for 'Okafor CRC 2026' (5 members) per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap: FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), patient messaged (comm-t0005) | She first looked excluded: age 66+, a frailty diagnosis and donepezil. Dr. Lin then marked the frailty entry (cond-00189) entered in error because it belonged to another patient (comm-00301), so that exclusion is gone. No other exclusion and no qualifying screening on record. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice care episode eoc-00002, 2026-06-16 to 08-21, during the measurement period. The outside discharge summary (doc-00402) confirms it. She later revoked hospice, but that doesn't change the exclusion. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0002), messaged (comm-t0006) | Her FIT (obs-01732) was corrected: the sample was collected 2025-12-31, not 2026-01-05. That is outside 2026, so it doesn't count. No other screening. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0003), messaged (comm-t0007) | Her 2024 stool DNA-FIT (obs-01871) was withdrawn by the lab as another patient's specimen and is now entered in error (doc-00401). Her 2025 colonoscopy order (sr-00003) was never done, so it doesn't count. That order is still active and I left it for Dr. Okafor to review. |
| pt-0073 Marisol Quintero (58) | Open gap: FIT ordered (sr-t0004), messaged (comm-t0008) | The lab cancelled her original FIT (obs-73001, now entered in error) and re-issued it (obs-05001, doc-00403) with a 2025-12-28 collection date. That is outside 2026, so it doesn't count. No other screening. |

All FIT kit orders run from 2026-10-23 to 2026-12-31. None of these patients had an active FIT order before. The patient messages say the kit is coming and explain how to collect and mail it back.

Before the new results arrived, every member was either excluded (pt-0009, pt-0020) or up to date (pt-0022, pt-0024, pt-0073). I hadn't placed any orders or sent any messages yet, so nothing needed undoing. Five items arrived at 08:00, and four of them changed a status to open gap (pt-0009, pt-0022, pt-0024, pt-0073). The fifth (pt-0020) confirmed the exclusion.

I wrote a progress note for each patient (doc-t0009 to doc-t0013) and closed those five inbox items with links to the orders and notes. A final queue check found no further arrivals. I didn't touch inbox items unrelated to this worklist.
